suppressed.triageReasonQuoted: Owner triage 2026-10-01: wont-fix. deadline = block.timestamp is ineffective as an expiry, but there is no threat: minPhusdOut/minLP (and the other min-out floors) are fixed at signing, so a held keeper transaction can only execute within the same tolerance bound the owner accepted for L-22 ycn20l22; pool() is keeper-gated, and delay gives a front-runner nothing beyond what same-block manipulation already gets. Covers the UniPoolerV2 (Q-20) and PromotionUniV2_Eth (Q-12) instances. The Uniboost.pool instance (SLITHER-026) has no ledger entry and is not covered.

Disposition does NOT cover sibling L-06 (342075dfba, BalancerPoolerV2.pool), which stays open, nor L-23 (shared-venue floor staleness), whose stale-floor mechanism could widen the effective tolerance beyond t.

suppressed.triageReasonQuoted: Owner triage 2026-10-01: wont-fix. Owner: "This is a mild inconvenience at most." Basis: a third-party dust pre-seed only trips the cutover's fail-loud reserves==(0,0) precondition, so the impact is delay on a one-off cutover; the griefer gains nothing and the skew is cheaply and profitably arbitraged back. Safe-recovery guidance retained (footgun): if the pair is pre-seeded, arbitrage it to the target ratio, then seed via direct transfer + pair.mint with a reserve-ratio assertion. Never relax the precondition or router-addLiquidity with zero mins into a skewed pair. Does not cover Q-19 ycn20q19 (pair not bound to router factory), which is triaged separately.
suppressed.note: Dust pre-seed half on UniPoolerV2 = L-24 (wont-fix). Canonical-pair half = Q-19 (fixed run-21, code unchanged) -- not a regression. The escrow-side delta is filed separately as DEDUP-001 (NEW).

triageReasonQuoted.L-23: Owner triage 2026-10-01: wont-fix. Owner: "The frequency of NFT minting is not live trading. This scenario is a lightning strike rather than a common inconvenience." Basis: the coupling only bites when UniPoolerV2.pool and PromotionUniV2_Eth Leg A land in the same block on stale quotes; at NFT-mint cadence that collision is rare, and extraction stays tolerance-bounded and POL-only (same tier as L-15 e64f73d629, L-06 342075dfba, L-22 ycn20l22, all wont-fix). Operational guidance retained: do not batch both calls in one block; quote the second after the first is mined. Revisit if dispatch cadence rises toward continuous/keeper-batched trading.
